name: pi-code-intel-guide
description: Guide pi agents to the dedicated code-intelligence toolchain: injects a retrieval protocol (symbol_search → ctx_compose → module_report/read_symbol → ctx_grep) and redirects shell recursive code-search (rg / grep -r / find -name / Select-String -Recurse). Evidence-driven: 10,640 shell search-read calls (8.8M tokens) while ctx_compose was used 4× in a 115-session corpus.
